question: A policeman saw a thief at a distance of 800m. When the policeman started chasing the thief, the thief started running. If the ratio of the speeds of the policeman to the thief is 3:2, then the distance travelled by the policeman to catch the thief is
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since the **time** of the chase is constant for both the policeman and the thief, **Distance** is directly proportional to **Speed**.

Ratio of Speeds (Policeman : Thief) = 3 : 2 ⇒ Ratio of Distances = 3 : 2.

Difference in distance units = 3 − 2 = 1 unit.

Given, 1 unit = 800 m.

Total distance traveled by the policeman = 3 units = 3 × 800 m = 2400 m = 2.4 km.

**∴ The correct answer is 2.4 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial distance between **Policeman** and **Thief** = 800 m.

Ratio of speed of **Policeman** (Vₚ) to **Thief** (Vₜ) = 3 : 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cdb691dba8c88dbac5864efcaffbfbfe85b39b7911b5b449e7260c4d08a800bf.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the speed of the **policeman** be 3x and the speed of the **thief** be 2x.

⇒ Relative speed in same direction = 3x − 2x = x.

⇒ Time taken to catch the thief = Initial Distance ÷ Relative Speed

⇒ Time (T) = 800 ÷ x

⇒ Distance covered by the **policeman** = Speed of policeman × Time

⇒ Distance = 3x × (800 ÷ x)

⇒ Distance = 3 × 800 = 2400 m

⇒ Distance in km = 2400 ÷ 1000 = 2.4 km

**∴ The correct answer is 2.4 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Concept

When two objects move in the **same direction**, the relative speed is the difference between their speeds: (u − v).

Distance and Speed Relation

When time is constant, the ratio of distances covered is **directly proportional** to the ratio of speeds (D₁/D₂ = S₁/S₂).

Unit Conversion

To convert **meters** to **kilometers**, divide the value by 1000 (1 km = 1000 m).</p
